predecessors.name: Tsardom of Russia
predecessors.text: the Belgorod Razriad frontier lands of the Tsardom, from which Sloboda Ukraine 'developed'

successors.name: Russian Empire
successors.text: the Sloboda Ukraine Governorate: 'In 1765, it was converted into the Sloboda Ukraine Governorate'

ledger.x: 1650: Sloboda Ukraine begins to be organised as a Cossack frontier region under the tsar.
1743: the Cossack capital leaves Sumy for Kharkiv.

certainty.note: The page gives only the modern oblasts that cover the region, no boundary and no area; the southern steppe frontier was open to the Wild Fields, and the Izium and Belgorod lines are not dated here.
